purpose: Attach verified normal-form skill acquisition events to the Stage 4-3 job tree using explicit JobLevelInfo.GotSkill_ID relations, while preserving HeroInfo and JobConnection skill references as separate evidence instead of conflating their semantics.

jobLevelFromStage43.gotSkillId: ConfigDataJobLevelInfo protobuf field 28, already preserved by Stage 4-3

fieldEvidence.jobLevelAcquisition: dump.cs explicitly defines ConfigDataJobLevelInfo.GotSkill_IDFieldNumber=28 and exposes m_gotSkillInfo, so this is the authoritative normal job-level acquisition edge.
fieldEvidence.connectionTalentSkills: dump.cs explicitly defines ConfigDataJobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDsFieldNumber=8. Its exact presentation semantics are preserved separately and are not silently treated as JobLevel acquisition events.
fieldEvidence.heroDirectSkills: ConfigDataHeroInfo Skill_IDs/HiddenSkill_IDs are preserved as direct hero-level references. Project evidence confirms HeroInfo field 19 can resolve directly to SkillInfo, e.g. Leon field 19 -> skill 10301. These sets are not assumed to equal the complete job-acquired skill set.
fieldEvidence.skillDetail: SkillInfo IDs are resolved to display metadata only after the explicit acquisition/reference edge has been established.

normalizationRules: Consume only Stage 4-3 PASS or REVIEW hero-job-tree output.
Use JobLevelInfo.GotSkill_ID as the authoritative source for normal job-level acquisition events.
Preserve the Stage 4-3 connection order and each connection's JobLevels_ID sequence when ordering acquisition events.
Do not infer acquisition order from Skill ID magnitude, skill name, icon path, wiki order, or HeroInfo.Skill_IDs order.
Resolve every nonzero GotSkill_ID against ConfigDataSkillInfo; a missing target is a hard relation error.
Preserve HeroInfo.Skill_IDs as heroDirectSkills and HiddenSkill_IDs as hiddenSkills. Do not merge them into job-level acquisition unless the same explicit GotSkill_ID edge exists.
Preserve JobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDs per connection as connectionTalentSkills. Do not reclassify them as ordinary acquired skills in Stage 4-4.
Allow the same Skill ID to appear in multiple acquisition events when separate branches or JobLevels explicitly reference it; deduplicate only the per-hero skill catalog, not the acquisition events.

Do not classify awakening, SP, talent, covenant, or other special presentation groups in Stage 4-4 unless the source relation explicitly identifies that role. Awakening grouping remains part of Stage 4-5.
SP reward/acquisition skills are out of scope and remain in the Stage 5 SP pipeline.

UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: Stage 4-3 hero-job-trees output is absent or has a status other than PASS/REVIEW.
SOURCE_BLOCKED: HeroInfo, JobConnectionInfo, or SkillInfo TextAsset is missing, structurally invalid, or has no usable m_bytes payload.
FAIL: A Stage 4-3 hero is missing from usable HeroInfo.
A Stage 4-3 JobConnection is missing from JobConnectionInfo.
Any nonzero JobLevel GotSkill_ID, HeroInfo Skill_ID/HiddenSkill_ID, or JobConnection TalentSkill_ID references a missing SkillInfo record.
Duplicate HeroInfo, JobConnectionInfo, or SkillInfo IDs exist.
REVIEW: A hero has no skill references from any Stage 4-4 source despite having a normal job tree.
A skill is referenced only by an auxiliary HeroInfo/JobConnection relation and never by a JobLevel acquisition edge; preserve it without inventing an acquisition point.
PASS: All explicit normal-form skill references resolve, all JobLevel acquisition events preserve verified job-tree order, and no hard relation error exists.

latestValidation.reviewReason: Auxiliary HeroInfo/JobConnection skill references exist without a JobLevel.GotSkill_ID acquisition point for multiple heroes; preserved as auxiliaryOnlySkillIds instead of inventing acquisition positions.

completionRule: Run npm run inspect:hero-skills after Stage 4-3. REVIEW is allowed when every explicit reference resolves but auxiliary skill references lack a verified JobLevel acquisition point; those references remain separate for later semantic classification.
nextStage: 4-5 complete the basic combat dataset: awakening classification, job stats, soldier modifiers, talent and star-rank talent changes.
